comments.body: Engineering's update on the S01E03 Challenge page says original #4471 closed on 5 October and marks the parser FIXED: fix(dates): parse dd/mm for eu locales. Closing this 379-report parser ticket as completed on that evidence. The separate booking-v3 hint cause is not fixed; it closes as not planned in issue 2. These are engineering-reported outcomes, not product tests run by this harness. The original report count and the five one-day descriptions remain in the audit trail. See the signed resolution page: src/routes/kb/incidents/4471-resolution/+page.svx and evidence/engineering-update.txt.
